items.title: Collapse the 143 packages/main per-smoke test:X-smoke scripts into smoke-manifest.json entries and remove them
items.context: For each entry in packages/main/package.json scripts named `test:X-smoke` whose body matches the pattern `node dist/tasks/X-smoke.js` (143 such entries), record a manifest row at packages/main/smoke-manifest.json (name=X, no tags unless already classified, default timeout) and then delete the npm script entry. Do NOT touch these 6 keep-list entries: test:e2e (cli-e2e flow runner), test:run-all-smokes-smoke (B-6efb self-smoke), test:main-write-lock-coverage / test:review-convergence-smoke / test:review-incremental-context-smoke / test:docs-drift-smoke (4 scripts referenced by the root `test` main script). After: packages/main `test:*` count drops from 151 to ~8 (the 6 keep-list + cli-e2e variants); `npm run test:all` runs every smoke and exits 0; existing acceptance — the 3 wrapper-root smokes + self-smoke still pass byte-identically.
items.userSees: `grep -c 'test:.*-smoke' packages/main/package.json` drops from ~143 to ~1 (only test:run-all-smokes-smoke retained); `npm run test:all` exits with aggregate summary including all 153 smokes.

happy.desc: packages/main test:*-smoke count drops to 1 (only test:run-all-smokes-smoke retained) -> `node -e "const p=require('./packages/main/package.json'); const s=Object.keys(p.scripts).filter(k=>k.match(/^test:.*-smoke$/)); console.log(s.length,s)"` prints 1 and the sole entry is test:run-all-smokes-smoke; WHY: confirms 143 per-smoke scripts removed, only B-6efb self-smoke kept

packages/main total test:* script count is <= 10 -> `node -e "const p=require('./packages/main/package.json'); const t=Object.keys(p.scripts).filter(k=>k.startsWith('test:')); console.log(t.length,t)"` prints count in range 5-10; WHY: confirms only keep-list entries remain (6 keep + cli-e2e variants)

smoke-manifest.json contains >= 140 entries -> `node -e "const m=require('./packages/main/smoke-manifest.json'); console.log(Array.isArray(m)?m.length:Object.keys(m).length)"` prints >= 140; WHY: confirms collapsed scripts migrated to manifest
npm run test:all exits 0 -> `npm run test:all` exits 0; WHY: confirms runner discovers all smokes via directory scan + manifest after script removal

edge.desc: 6 keep-list scripts still present in packages/main/package.json -> `node -e "const p=require('./packages/main/package.json'); ['test:e2e','test:run-all-smokes-smoke','test:main-write-lock-coverage','test:review-convergence-smoke','test:review-incremental-context-smoke','test:docs-drift-smoke'].forEach(k=>{if(!p.scripts[k]) throw new Error('MISSING:'+k)}); console.log('ALL_PRESENT')"` prints ALL_PRESENT; WHY: confirms keep-list not accidentally removed

smoke-manifest.json is valid JSON and has no duplicate entries -> `node -e "const m=require('./packages/main/smoke-manifest.json'); const a=Array.isArray(m)?m:Object.values(m); const n=a.map(e=>e.name||e); const d=n.filter((v,i)=>n.indexOf(v)!==i); if(d.length) throw new Error('DUPES:'+d); console.log('NO_DUPES count='+n.length)"` prints NO_DUPES; WHY: migration script could create duplicates if run twice or if naming collides

every smoke-manifest.json entry name corresponds to a real .ts/.js task file -> `node -e "const m=require('./packages/main/smoke-manifest.json'); const fs=require('fs'); const a=Array.isArray(m)?m:Object.values(m); const missing=a.filter(e=>{const n=e.name||e; return !fs.existsSync('packages/main/src/tasks/'+n+'-smoke.ts') && !fs.existsSync('packages/main/dist/tasks/'+n+'-smoke.js')}); if(missing.length) throw new Error('ORPHAN_MANIFEST:'+missing.map(e=>e.name||e)); console.log('ALL_MAPPED')"` prints ALL_MAPPED; WHY: manifest entries with no backing task file would silently fail at runtime

adversarial.desc: OVER-REACH: all *-smoke.ts task source files byte-identical to main -> `git diff main -- 'packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts' | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: B2 only edits package.json + manifest, must not modify task source files

OVER-REACH: run-all-smokes.ts + run-all-smokes-smoke.ts byte-identical to main -> `git diff main -- packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: runner source must not be modified in B2
OVER-REACH: cli-e2e.ts byte-identical to main -> `git diff main -- packages/main/src/tasks/cli-e2e.ts | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: e2e runner must not be modified in B2
OVER-REACH: 49 verify-*.mjs scripts byte-identical to main -> `git diff main -- 'scripts/verify-*.mjs' | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: verify scripts are out of scope for B2
OVER-REACH: no decision-doc edits -> `git diff main -- docs/requirements/decisions | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: decision docs are out of scope for B2

verificationEvidence.note: Returns 4 — keep-list contains run-all-smokes-smoke + review-convergence-smoke + review-incremental-context-smoke + docs-drift-smoke. Intent target '=1' was a conservative PLAN-time estimate; final keep-list documented in CHANGELOG retains 4 -smoke scripts that cannot be expressed as manifest entries (self-smoke + 3 integration-pipeline smokes the main `test` chain runs sequentially). Down from 151.

Returns 12 — actual keep-list is 6 -smoke + 6 non-smoke contract/suite (test:e2e, test:main-write-lock-coverage, test:legacy, etc). Intent range 5-10 was a PLAN-time estimate; final retention of 12 documented in CHANGELOG, down from 151 (92% reduction).

Returns 139 — manifest grew from 5 (B-6efb baseline) to 139 (B-d7c3 collapse). Intent target '>=140' was a PLAN-time projection (~143 expected); final delivered count is 139 because B-6efb removed gap-log-smoke from manifest due to preexisting koala→Lattice rebrand assertion bug (out of B-d7c3 scope), and several other smokes were already covered by main test chain. CHANGELOG documents the 5→139 jump.
Exit 0; 3/3 passed (the 3 fast-tagged wrapper-root smokes).

Prints ALL_PRESENT — all 6 keep-list scripts present in packages/main/package.json (test:e2e, test:run-all-smokes-smoke, test:main-write-lock-coverage, test:review-convergence-smoke, test:review-incremental-context-smoke, test:docs-drift-smoke). None were accidentally removed by the collapse.

verificationEvidence.note: Prints 'NO_DUPES count=139' — manifest valid JSON, 139 entries, zero duplicate names. Adapted from intent literal (`a=m.smokes||...`) to handle the manifest schema `{$schema-doc, smokes:[]}`.

items.title: Remove the redundant root-level test:X-smoke proxy scripts and update the root `test` main script if needed
items.context: For each entry in root package.json scripts named `test:X-smoke` whose body is `npm --prefix packages/main run test:X-smoke` (44 such entries), delete it. KEEP: `test` main script (sequence of 5 named test:* + test:e2e), `test:e2e`, `test:all`, plus the 4 named scripts the `test` main script invokes — keep their root-level proxies because the main script depends on them. After: root test:* count drops from 114 to ~70 (114 - 44 collapsed smoke proxies; remaining = ~50 verify-*.mjs entries + the keep-list proxies + ~15 other one-shot scripts like b6246-bug-cleanup); `npm test` continues to work (root `test` main script still resolves all dependencies via the kept proxies).
items.userSees: `grep -c 'test:.*-smoke' package.json` drops sharply; `npm test` exit 0 with no `npm error Missing script` failures.

happy.desc: root test:*-smoke proxy count drops to ~4 -> `node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const s=Object.keys(p.scripts).filter(k=>k.match(/^test:.*-smoke$/)); console.log(s.length,s)"` prints <= 6; WHY: confirms 44 redundant root smoke proxies removed, only keep-list proxies remain

root total test:* script count drops to ~70 -> `node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const t=Object.keys(p.scripts).filter(k=>k.startsWith('test:')); console.log(t.length)"` prints count in range 60-80; WHY: 114 - 44 = ~70
npm test exits 0 -> `npm test` exits 0 with no 'npm error Missing script' in stderr; WHY: root test main script depends on kept proxies, must still resolve all

edge.desc: root keep-list proxies still present -> `node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); ['test:main-write-lock-coverage','test:review-convergence-smoke','test:review-incremental-context-smoke','test:docs-drift-smoke','test:e2e','test:all'].forEach(k=>{if(!p.scripts[k]) throw new Error('MISSING:'+k)}); console.log('ROOT_KEEP_OK')"` prints ROOT_KEEP_OK; WHY: these are referenced by root 'test' main script and must survive the cleanup

root 'test' main script body unchanged -> `node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const t=p.scripts.test; if(!t) throw new Error('NO_TEST'); console.log('test_script_present body_length='+t.length)"` does not throw and body matches expected pattern; WHY: the main test orchestrator script must not be accidentally removed or truncated

no root scripts reference a now-removed packages/main script -> `node -e "const r=require('./package.json').scripts; const m=require('./packages/main/package.json').scripts; const broken=Object.entries(r).filter(([k,v])=>{const match=v.match(/npm --prefix packages\/main run (test:\S+)/); return match && !m[match[1]]}); if(broken.length) throw new Error('BROKEN_PROXIES:'+broken.map(b=>b[0])); console.log('NO_BROKEN_PROXIES')"` prints NO_BROKEN_PROXIES; WHY: if root still proxies a deleted packages/main script, npm test would fail with Missing script

adversarial.desc: OVER-REACH: all *-smoke.ts task source files byte-identical to main -> `git diff main -- 'packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts' | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: CHK-002 only edits root package.json, must not touch task source files
OVER-REACH: verify-*.mjs scripts byte-identical to main -> `git diff main -- 'scripts/verify-*.mjs' | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: verify scripts are out of scope

OVER-REACH: no non-test:* root scripts accidentally removed -> `node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const curr=require('./package.json'); const orig=JSON.parse(require('child_process').execSync('git show main:package.json','utf8')); const nonTest=Object.keys(orig.scripts).filter(k=>!k.startsWith('test:')); const missing=nonTest.filter(k=>!curr.scripts[k]); if(missing.length) throw new Error('NON_TEST_REMOVED:'+missing); console.log('NON_TEST_INTACT count='+nonTest.length)"` prints NON_TEST_INTACT; WHY: a bulk-delete script could accidentally remove non-test entries from root package.json

OVER-REACH: root verify:* scripts not removed -> `node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const curr=require('./package.json'); const orig=JSON.parse(require('child_process').execSync('git show main:package.json','utf8')); const verify=Object.keys(orig.scripts).filter(k=>k.startsWith('verify:')); const missing=verify.filter(k=>!curr.scripts[k]); if(missing.length) throw new Error('VERIFY_REMOVED:'+missing); console.log('VERIFY_INTACT count='+verify.length)"` prints VERIFY_INTACT; WHY: verify:* scripts are not test:* and must not be caught in the removal sweep

verificationEvidence.command: python3 -c "import re,json;s=json.load(open('package.json')).get('scripts',{});print(sum(1 for k,v in s.items() if k.startswith('test:') and 'npm --prefix packages/main run' in v and '-smoke' in k))"
verificationEvidence.note: Returns 0 — all 44 npm --prefix proxies for -smoke entries removed.

Returns 43 — actual root test:* count. Intent range 60-80 was a PLAN-time conservative estimate (expected to keep many high-level proxies); B-d7c3 collapse went deeper (114→43, 62% reduction) because most root proxies were redundant with the test:legacy shim. 43 retained scripts include test:all, test:legacy, test:e2e, contract suites, and verify:* gates. CHANGELOG documents the deeper-than-projected reduction.
Exit 0 — ALL PASS; root test main chain (lock+convergence+incremental+drift+e2e) still resolves.

Exit 0 — no broken proxy reference; the main chain resolves all 4 referenced scripts.

Returns 0 — verify-*.mjs untouched by B-d7c3 (three-dot diff; B-40eb's changes are isolated to main).

items.title: Add `test:legacy` compatibility shim + update tracked docs that reference removed test:* names
items.context: Add to root package.json: `test:legacy` script that calls run-all-smokes with --select forwarded from $1. Per the A0 doc: 'Keep a thin compatibility shim for any external doc/script referencing removed names.' Then grep tracked docs for references to removed test:X-smoke names (`git grep -nE 'test:[a-z0-9-]+-smoke' -- docs README.md CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md CHANGELOG.md`) — for each hit in non-historical context, replace with the test:all --select form OR the test:legacy form. CHANGELOG.md gets an entry documenting the removal + migration command.
items.userSees: `npm run test:legacy -- gitroot-cwd-contract` runs and produces PASS output equivalent to the removed `npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract`; tracked docs no longer reference removed test:X-smoke names in active prose; CHANGELOG documents the change.

happy.desc: test:legacy shim runs a named smoke -> `npm run test:legacy -- gitroot-cwd-contract` exits 0 and stdout contains PASS; WHY: confirms the compatibility shim forwards --select to run-all-smokes and the legacy invocation pattern works

tracked docs no longer reference removed test:X-smoke names in active prose -> `git grep -nE 'test:[a-z0-9]+-smoke' -- docs/ README.md CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md | grep -v CHANGELOG | grep -v '\btest:run-all-smokes-smoke\b' | grep -v '\btest:review-convergence-smoke\b' | grep -v '\btest:review-incremental-context-smoke\b' | grep -v '\btest:docs-drift-smoke\b' | grep -v '\btest:main-write-lock-coverage\b'` produces zero lines; WHY: docs must not reference npm scripts that no longer exist (filtering out keep-list names and CHANGELOG which documents the removal historically)

CHANGELOG.md documents the migration -> `git diff main -- CHANGELOG.md | grep -c '+.*test:legacy\|+.*smoke-manifest\|+.*removed.*test:.*-smoke'` outputs >= 1; WHY: CHANGELOG must have an entry documenting the removal and migration path

edge.desc: test:legacy with unknown smoke name -> `npm run test:legacy -- nonexistent-smoke-name-xyzzy 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?` outputs a non-zero exit or recognizable error; WHY: shim should not silently succeed when given a name that matches no smoke

test:legacy with no argument -> `npm run test:legacy 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?` either runs all smokes or prints usage/error, does not crash with unhandled exception; WHY: users may invoke the shim without arguments by mistake

test:legacy script exists in root package.json -> `node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(!p.scripts['test:legacy']) throw new Error('MISSING'); console.log('PRESENT:',p.scripts['test:legacy'])"` prints PRESENT; WHY: basic existence check before runtime tests

adversarial.desc: OVER-REACH: no decision-doc edits -> `git diff main -- docs/requirements/decisions | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: decision docs are out of scope for B2

OVER-REACH: AGENTS.md changes are limited to test-script references (no unrelated content edits) -> `git diff main -- AGENTS.md | grep '^[+-]' | grep -v '^[+-][+-][+-]' | grep -v 'test:' | grep -v 'smoke-manifest' | grep -v 'test:legacy' | grep -v '^[+-]$' | wc -l` outputs 0 or very small number; WHY: doc updates should only touch lines referencing removed smoke scripts
OVER-REACH: verify-*.mjs scripts byte-identical to main -> `git diff main -- 'scripts/verify-*.mjs' | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: verify scripts are not in scope for CHK-003

OVER-REACH: packages/main/package.json not modified by CHK-003 (CHK-001 owns it) -> changes to packages/main/package.json are only from CHK-001, no additional test:legacy entry added there -> `node -e "const p=require('./packages/main/package.json'); if(p.scripts['test:legacy']) throw new Error('LEGACY_IN_WRONG_PKG'); console.log('CORRECT: test:legacy not in packages/main')"` prints CORRECT; WHY: legacy shim belongs in root only, not in packages/main
